qa_pairs.question: What is the resistance value of the auxiliary fan normal speed blower resistor?
Which fuse protects the high speed relay circuit for the auxiliary fan?
At what temperature does the dual temperature switch close for the high speed fan operation?
What wire color connects from the dual temperature switch terminal 2 to the normal speed relay?
What happens when the A/C compressor controls request the auxiliary fan to operate?
qa_pairs.answer: The fan operates through the normal speed relay via connector C204 with a 1 BK/VI wire signal

qa_pairs.question: At what temperature does the dual temperature switch close for normal speed fan operation?
What wire color supplies power from FUSE 20 to the control switches?
How is the auxiliary fan circuit different when the engine is running versus not running?
qa_pairs.answer: When running, power comes from the unloader relay K7, when not running it comes hot at all times through C100

qa_pairs.question: What connector supplies the evaporator temperature regulator with power?
